description: This PHP class 'ImportFileSplitter' handles splitting a large CSV file into smaller parts based on a record threshold. It includes methods for checking file existence, splitting files with optional header handling, and retrieving details about the split files and record counts.

classes.name: ImportFileSplitter
classes.description: Class to handle splitting a file into separate parts, with methods for validation, splitting, and retrieving split file info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the splitter with a source file and optional record threshold.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if the source file exists and is readable.

methods.name: splitSourceFile
methods.description: Splits the source file into multiple files based on the record threshold, with optional header handling.

methods.name: getRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of records in the source file after splitting.

methods.name: getFileCount
methods.description: Returns the number of split files created.

methods.name: getSplitFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of a specific split file given its number.
